tasks.label: build-release
tasks.command: mkdir -p build && cd build && g++ -std=c++17 -O3 -march=native -ffast-math -fopenmp -mavx2 -mfma -I/usr/local/include -I.. -I../aff3ct_randn_gen -I../aff3ct_randn_gen/MIPP/src -o simulator ../main.cpp -lfftw3 -lfftw3_threads -lm

tasks.label: build-debug
tasks.command: mkdir -p build && cd build && g++ -std=c++17 -O0 -g -mavx2 -mfma -I/usr/local/include -I.. -I../aff3ct_randn_gen -I../aff3ct_randn_gen/MIPP/src -o simulator_debug ../main.cpp -lfftw3 -lm
